Tenda W6S 300Mbps In-wall Wireless Access Point

The Tenda W6S is a wireless access point that can be wall-mounted to offer Wi-Fi coverage for your house or workplace. The IEEE 802.11b/g/n network protocols are supported by the W6S, which can enable data transmission speeds of up to 300 Mbps in the 2.4 GHz frequency range. The W6S includes two LAN ports, one for PoE+Data input and the other for data output, which may be used to connect to wired devices or to extend your network. On the front panel, there is also a reset button and a SYS LED indication. It includes two inbuilt antennas with a gain of 2 dBi, allowing it to offer robust and dependable wireless communications. The W6S also offers a 1 dBm adjustable transmission power, which allows you to improve Wi-Fi performance and decrease interference. To safeguard your network from illegal access, the W6S supports a variety of security protocols, including WEP, WPA-PSK, WPA2-PSK, WPA/WPA2-PSK, WPA, and WPA2. The Tenda W6S 300Mbps In-wall Wireless Access Point also supports VPN pass-through for the PPTP and L2TP protocols, allowing for secure distant network access. It has two modes of operation: AP and Client+AP. In AP mode, the W6S may function as a stand-alone wireless access point, allowing your wireless devices to connect to the internet. In Client+AP mode, it can link to another wireless access point while also providing Wi-Fi connectivity to your wireless devices. The Tenda W6S 300Mbps In-wall Wireless Access Point offers a web-based administration interface that allows you to customize settings including time and date, system log, firmware upgrading, backup/restore configuration, and username management.

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Stackable L3 Managed Switch with SFP Port is a high-performance enterprise networking solution. Built for SMBs, enterprises, and ISPs that need scalable, reliable, and feature-rich Layer 3 switching at the network convergence layer. It delivers 128 Gbps switching capacity per unit with 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10 Gbps SFP+ slots for fast and flexible wired connectivity. This TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch supports physical stacking of up to 8 units, dual redundant power supplies, and full Omada SDN integration for centralized cloud management.

Port Configuration

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Switch provides 24 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ slots for high-density wired connectivity across enterprise network deployments. A switching capacity of 128 Gbps per unit and a packet forwarding rate of 95.2 Mpps ensure the switch handles demanding traffic loads without bottlenecks during peak operation. A 32K MAC address table, 3MB packet buffer memory, and 9KB jumbo frame support enable efficient and high-volume data processing across all connected devices. Two USB 2.0 ports, one RJ45 console port, one USB Type-C console port, and one dedicated RJ45 management port provide comprehensive access and configuration options.

Switching Performance

Physical stacking supports up to 4 units per stack group with each 10G SFP+ uplink port usable as a stacking port at 20 Gbps full-duplex stack bandwidth. This stacking capability scales the network to 8 units for built-in redundancy and expanded port density without complex configuration changes. The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch uses Store-and-Forward transmission for reliable and error-free packet delivery across all connected network segments. Four internal fixed fans and a maximum power consumption of 28.4W at 220V ensure efficient and thermally managed continuous operation.

Layer 3 Routing

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Switch delivers comprehensive Layer 3 routing capabilities including Static Routing, RIP v1/v2, OSPF v2/v3, ECMP with up to 32 nexthops per destination, VRRP v2/v3, and DHCP Server and Relay for scalable network architectures. IPv4 supports up to 256 IP interfaces, 1024 static routes, and a host route table of up to 6100 entries for extensive routing table capacity. PIM-DM and PIM-SM multicast routing protocols ensure efficient multicast traffic delivery across complex network topologies. DHCP Server supports up to 8K IP pools and 1000 manual binding entries for comprehensive address management in large network deployments.

Layer 2 Features

With Layer 2 features include Link Aggregation, Spanning Tree Protocol, ERPS for ring topology protection and recovery, Port Mirroring, RSPAN, and 802.3x Flow Control for robust and resilient network operation. IGMP Snooping, MLD Snooping, Multicast VLAN Registration, and support for 2048 IGMP groups deliver efficient multicast traffic management across the network. Up to 4K VLAN groups using 802.1Q, MAC VLAN, Protocol VLAN, QinQ, Voice VLAN, Private VLAN, and GVRP provide extensive traffic segmentation capabilities. The TP-Link Managed Switch also supports 802.3ah Ethernet Link OAM, L2PT, DLDP, DDM, and sFlow for comprehensive ISP-grade feature coverage.

TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch is a cost-effective network upgrade for simple management beyond basic plug-and-play switching. The Switch provides 16 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports with AUTO Negotiation and AUTO MDI/MDIX on every port for effortless connectivity. This TP-Link TL-SG1016DE Switch delivers a 32 Gbps switching capacity and a 23.8 Mpps packet forwarding rate for fast and reliable network throughput.

16 Gigabit Port

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Switch delivers 32 Gbps switching capacity and a 23.8 Mpps packet forwarding rate across all 16 Gigabit RJ45 ports simultaneously. An 8K MAC address table and 4.1 Mbit packet buffer memory ensure efficient traffic handling and minimal packet loss under busy network conditions. Jumbo frame support up to 10KB allows large data transfers across the network without fragmentation or performance degradation. The switch supports 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, and 1000BASE-T network media standards with cable runs up to 100 meters on appropriate UTP or STP cabling.

QoS and Traffic Management

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch supports Port-based, 802.1p, and DSCP priority modes with four priority queues for precise and flexible traffic prioritization. Rate Limiting and Storm Control features actively manage bandwidth usage and protect the network from broadcast, multicast, and unknown-unicast traffic flooding. Build and expand your lightning-fast network with TP-Link TL-SX3016F—a fully managed switch with full 16-port 10G fiber ports and 320 Gbps switching capacity. Advanced L3 Features

An abundance of L2+ and L3 features are supported to help build a highly scalable and robust network, providing a reliable and efficient solution for enterprises, campuses and ISPs.

Secure Networking

Our high-quality security features defend against a range of network threats. They include IP-MAC-Port-VID Binding, Port Security, Storm Control, and DHCP Snooping. An integrated list of common DoS attacks is available, making it easier than ever to prevent them. Static Routing segments the network to route traffic efficiently.

ISP Features & IPv6 Support

The TRENDnet TEG-082WS is an 8-port Web Smart Gigabit switch with two shared SFP ports, designed for high-performance networking. Its 16Gbps switching capacity and full-duplex Gigabit rates of up to 2000Mbps per port assure smooth data transfer for companies, data centers, and VoIP applications. The TRENDnet TEG-082WS 8-Port Web Smart Gigabit Switch supports IEEE 802.1D STP, 802.1w RSTP, and 802.1s MSTP for spanning tree protocols, which ensure network stability and loop prevention. Consistent service quality and reliable connecting ability in a converged network is the key for Carrier to connect and satisfy customers; therefore the ability to control traffic flow and set traffic policy becomes more critical than ever. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers wire-speed flow control that classifies and prioritizes the incoming packets according to the predefine QoS policies that meet the requirements of service providers. In terms of classification, the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) field and the 802.1p Class of Service (CoS) field are identified to assess the priority of incoming packets. Classification and reclassification can be based on criteria as specific as rules based on IP, MAC addresses, VLAN ID, or TCP/UDP port number. For bandwidth management, the MES3500 series provides 8 priority queues per port for different types of traffics, allowing service providers to set policy-based rate limitations that take full advantage of constrained network resources and guarantee the best performance. Avoiding subscribers affecting each other on a shared network or shared device is a major concern for service providers. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers a complete set of security features to protect user data while administrating the traffics. Port security provides the ability to deny unauthorized users from accessing the network. Moreover, the 802.1X feature cooperating with RADIUS is useful to prevent unauthorized access based on username and password (or other credentials) and acts as powerful access control for converged networks with mixed wired and wireless access. The MES3500 series provides a multilayer (L2/L3/L4) ACL suite of sophisticated policy-based control mechanisms that enables service providers to deploy easily based on actual network environment needs via a Web GUI or command-line interface to prevent abnormal or illegal access. The policies can be defined to deny packets based on source and destination MAC addresses, IP addresses, or TCP/UDP ports. A quick recovery and round-the-clock network are vital for service providers to establish a robust network. The MES3500 series provides comprehensive features to make sure the network is well operated. The IEEE 802.3ad Link Aggregation feature reduces network downtime by providing redundant paths and bandwidth aggregation to critical connections, while IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP) and IEEE 802.1s Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol (MSTP) allow immediate recovery from failed connections by sending packets via the backup link. The enhanced digital interface allows real-time access to the device operating parameters, and it includes optional digital features such as soft control and monitoring of SFP I/O signals. In addition, the MES3500 series fully incorporates the functionality needed to implement digital alarms and warnings from fault isolation and failure prediction tasks as well as component monitoring features, among others. With the digital diagnostic monitoring interface, the MES3500 series enables users to easily detect packet loss from transceivers and aging cables; therefore users can not only avoid troubles such as unstable networking services but also boost productivity significantly. As Zyxel considers IPv6 management features as a future trend, complete IPv6 host management capabilities are added to the MES3500 series for guaranteed IPv6/4 migration and future-proof expansion. Itâ€™s not only beneficial for high-density Fast Ethernet deployments but also capable of preventing investment loss and therefore perfectly suitable for both network cores and edges.

OFDMA support in the 802.11ax Wi-Fi standard divides each channel into small sub-channels, allowing signals from multiple devices* to be bundled together and transmitted simultaneously, reducing latency for a smoother, more responsive Wi-Fi experience. Cudy M1800 AX1800 Whole Home Mesh WiFi 6 Router (1 Pack)

The Cudy M1800 AX1800 Whole Home Mesh WiFi Router features High-Performance Dual Core CPU with 32MB Flash and 256MB DDR3. It comes with 5 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports and it has 4 x 5dBi High Gain Antennas. 4x5dBi High gain antennas boost the sensitivity of the WiFi router, create connections over greater distances, providing powerful penetration through walls. 2.4GHz provides an extremely long-range, 5GHz reaches 1201Mbps, ideal for gaming and 4K streaming. Simple tasks like web browsing can be handled by the 2.4GHz band, while bandwidth-intensive tasks like online gaming or HD video streaming can be processed by the 5GHz band at the same time. It is a 2-IN-1 WiFi Router / Access Point. When working in router mode, it can quickly establish a connection with the Internet through dial-up, so that all devices connected to it can enjoy high-speed networks. When working in the access point mode, usually a modem or router is required in front of it to dial and play the role of DHCP server, it only undertakes the role of data forwarding. The Cudy M1800 Router comes with built-in PPTP / L2TP VPN Clients, this router can easily establish a connection to VPN Server to transport all your online data and traffic, securing it with its encryption at the same time. You can use this function to connect your home network with your work network or school network. You can bind your home IP address to a custom domain name through the DDNS function. No matter how the IP changes, the domain name can point to your network, which makes remote management possible. The Cudy M1800 comes with a 1-year warranty.

The Netis NC21 Dual Band Router, powered by a 1GHz CPU and the RTL8197FH-VG5+RTL8812FR chipset with 128MB DDR and 8MB flash, efficiently handles data from several connected devices.
